evidence_text: Earn 4.75% APY on balances up to $50,000 for the first three months after account opening. After the introductory period, the account earns the standard variable rate. Balances above $50,000 earn the standard variable rate throughout.
claim_statement: The 4.75% APY applies to the entire account balance for six months.
source_page_text: Earn 4.75% APY on balances up to $50,000 for the first three months after account opening. After the introductory period, the account earns the standard variable rate. Balances above $50,000 earn the standard variable rate throughout. The promotional APY is available on accounts opened by September 15.
judgment_explanation: The promotional rate applies only to balances up to $50,000 and only for the first three months. The remaining balance earns the standard variable rate, and the stated duration is not six months.
